summary: List Specification Sections for a Project
description: This endpoint returns a paginated list of Specification Sections for a Project.

parameters.name: specification_area_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the specification area.

parameters.name: filter_set_id
parameters.description: Filter by specification set ID. Use `none` for sections without a set.

parameters.name: filter_division_id
parameters.description: Filter by a single specification section division ID.

parameters.name: search_string
parameters.description: Search string to filter sections by number, description, division, set, or revision.

parameters.name: filters[division_ids]
parameters.description: List of Unique identifier for the specification division(s).

parameters.name: exclude_ids
parameters.description: Exclude records by ids from the response

parameters.name: viewable_document_id_required
parameters.description: When `true`, only return sections whose current revision has a viewable document (i.e. `viewable_document_id` is populated). Defaults to `false`, which returns sections regardless.

data.description: List of specifications sections for current project

description.description: Specification Section Description as free form text

403.description: User does not have right permissions
